title: Iran claims supertanker with 2 million barrels sank after hitting a mine in Hormuz
detail: Iran claims a supertanker carrying about 2 million barrels of oil sank after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating its Nov 13-14 claims of mine strikes on tankers. The report comes via an aggregated feed and is not independently verified; the vessel is unnamed and no confirmation from shipowners or maritime authorities has been seen. If confirmed, it would raise freight, insurance and food/fertiliser import cost risks.
